summary: FURNISHED DOUBLE ROOM IN PROFESSIONAL SHARED HOUSE FIRST MONTH RENT HALF PRICE! My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this newly renovated, furnished double room in a seven bedroom shared house of professionals. This large double bedroom is located on the first floor, comes fully furnished, and includes all bills. Also includes Council Tax. The property itself is close to the town centre and has great transport links. Property comprises of: Furnished Double Bedroom, Shared Lounge, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen, Shared Bathroom.
